name: SpecLock
tagline: Check AI coding actions against explicit project constraints
description: SpecLock turns rules from CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and related instruction files into constraints that coding agents can check before changing protected code. Its local-first MCP server provides tools for reviewing planned actions, semantic conflicts, affected files, and patches. MCP use is assisted verification; enable SpecLock's Git or CI enforcement when checks must run independently of the agent.

install.notes: Run npx speclock@latest protect in a project to extract constraints and add Git-level protection. MCP checks depend on the agent invoking them.
